name: @gridicles/worker
description: Cloudflare Worker + Durable Objects for real-time puzzle rooms.

scripts.dev: npm run ensure-assets-dir && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --var APP_ORIGIN:http://localhost:5173 ACROSTIC_ORIGIN:http://localhost:5173 CROSSWORD_ORIGIN:http://localhost:5175 SIGN_IN_ORIGIN:http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_DOMAIN:
scripts.dev:crossword: npm run ensure-assets-dir && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --env crossword --port 8789 --var APP_ORIGIN:http://localhost:5175 ACROSTIC_ORIGIN:http://localhost:5173 CROSSWORD_ORIGIN:http://localhost:5175 SIGN_IN_ORIGIN:http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_DOMAIN:
scripts.ensure-assets-dir: node -e "for (const d of ['../web/dist', '../web/dist-crossword']) require('node:fs').mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true })"
